items.source: Variant of WebDataBinderFactory.createBinder(NativeWebRequest, Object, String) with a ResolvableType for which the DataBinder is created.
items.translation: `WebDataBinderFactory.createBinder(NativeWebRequest, Object, String)` 的变体，用于创建 `DataBinder` 的 `ResolvableType`。

items.source: Invoked after a DeferredResult has been set, via DeferredResult.setResult(Object) or DeferredResult.setErrorResult(Object), and is also ready to handle the concurrent result.
items.translation: 在通过 DeferredResult.setResult(Object) 或 DeferredResult.setErrorResult(Object) 设置 DeferredResult 后调用，并且也已准备好处理并发结果。

items.source: Create a new WebDataBinder for the given target object and initialize it through a WebBindingInitializer.
items.translation: 为给定的目标对象创建一个新的WebDataBinder，并通过一个WebBindingInitializer对其进行初始化。

items.source: Create a new HttpInputMessage from the given NativeWebRequest.
items.translation: 从给定的NativeWebRequest创建一个新的HttpInputMessage。

items.source: Create a new HttpOutputMessage from the given NativeWebRequest.
items.translation: 从给定的NativeWebRequest创建一个新的HttpOutputMessage。

items.source: Extension point to further initialize the created data binder instance (for example, with @InitBinder methods) after "global" initialization via WebBindingInitializer.
items.translation: 用于在通过WebBindingInitializer进行“全局”初始化后，进一步初始化已创建的数据绑定器实例（例如使用@InitBinder方法）的扩展点。

items.source: Invoked when a named value is required, but AbstractNamedValueMethodArgumentResolver.resolveName(String, MethodParameter, NativeWebRequest) returned null and there is no default value.
items.translation: 在需要命名值但AbstractNamedValueMethodArgumentResolver.resolveName(String, MethodParameter, NativeWebRequest)返回了null且没有默认值时调用。

items.source: Handle the given return value by adding attributes to the model and setting a view or setting the ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean) flag to true to indicate the response has been handled directly.
items.translation: 处理给定的返回值，通过向模型添加属性并设置视图，或者将ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean)标志设置为true，以指示响应已被直接处理。

items.source: Downcast to ServletRequestDataBinder to invoke bind(ServletRequest).
items.translation: 向下转换为ServletRequestDataBinder以调用bind(ServletRequest)。

items.source: Downcast to ServletRequestDataBinder to invoke constructTarget(ServletRequest).
items.translation: 向下转换为ServletRequestDataBinder以调用constructTarget(ServletRequest)。

items.source: An alternative to AbstractMappingContentNegotiationStrategy.resolveMediaTypes(NativeWebRequest) that accepts an already extracted key.
items.translation: `AbstractMappingContentNegotiationStrategy.resolveMediaTypes(NativeWebRequest)` 的替代方案，它接受一个已提取的键。

items.source: Create a WebDataBinder for the given object.
items.translation: 为给定对象创建WebDataBinder。

items.source: Required for access to NativeWebRequest in AbstractWebArgumentResolverAdapter.supportsParameter(MethodParameter).
items.translation: 访问 `AbstractWebArgumentResolverAdapter.supportsParameter(MethodParameter)` 中的 `NativeWebRequest` 所必需。

items.source: Add non-null return values to the ModelAndViewContainer.
items.translation: 向ModelAndViewContainer添加非空返回值。

items.source: Delegate to the WebArgumentResolver instance.
items.translation: 委托给 `WebArgumentResolver` 实例。

items.source: Iterate over registered HandlerMethodReturnValueHandlers and invoke the one that supports it.
items.translation: 遍历已注册的HandlerMethodReturnValueHandlers并调用支持它的那个。

items.source: Returns an instance of ExtendedServletRequestDataBinder.
items.translation: 返回一个ExtendedServletRequestDataBinder实例。

items.source: Resolve the given request to a list of media types.
items.translation: 将给定的请求解析为媒体类型列表。

items.translation: `org.springframework.web.accept` 中 `NativeWebRequest` 的用法

items.source: Uses of NativeWebRequest in org.springframework.web.bind.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.bind.support` 包中 `NativeWebRequest` 的用法

items.source: Uses of NativeWebRequest in org.springframework.web.context.request
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.context.request` 包中 `NativeWebRequest` 的用法

items.source: Uses of NativeWebRequest in org.springframework.web.context.request.async
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.context.request.async` 包中 `NativeWebRequest` 的用法

items.source: Uses of NativeWebRequest in org.springframework.web.method.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.method.annotation` 包中 `NativeWebRequest` 的用法

items.source: Uses of NativeWebRequest in org.springframework.web.method.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.method.support` 中 `NativeWebRequest` 的用法

items.source: Uses of NativeWebRequest in org.springframework.web.multipart.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.multipart.support` 包中 `NativeWebRequest` 的用法

items.source: Uses of NativeWebRequest in org.springframework.web.servlet.handler
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.servlet.handler` 包中 `NativeWebRequest` 的用法

items.source: Uses of NativeWebRequest in org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.annotation` 中 `NativeWebRequest` 的用法

items.source: Uses of NativeWebRequest in org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation` 包中 `NativeWebRequest` 的用法

items.source: ServletWebRequest subclass that is aware of DispatcherServlet's request context, such as the Locale determined by the configured LocaleResolver.
items.translation: `ServletWebRequest` 子类，能够感知 `DispatcherServlet` 的请求上下文，例如由配置的 `LocaleResolver` 确定的区域设置。

items.source: Invoked after the start of concurrent handling in the async thread in which the Callable is executed and before the actual invocation of the Callable.
items.translation: 在异步线程中启动并发处理的之后、且实际调用Callable的之前被调用。

items.source: WebRequest adapter for a JSF FacesContext.
items.translation: WebRequest 适配器用于 JSF FacesContext。

items.source: WebRequest adapter for an HttpServletRequest.
items.translation: WebRequest 适配器用于 HttpServletRequest。

items.source: Invoked after the Callable has produced a result in the async thread in which the Callable is executed.
items.translation: 在异步线程中调用 `Callable` 产生结果后，再调用。

items.source: Set ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean) to false to indicate that the method signature provides access to the response.
items.translation: 将 `ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean)` 设置为`false`，以表明该方法签名提供了对响应的访问权限。

items.source: Extends NativeWebRequest with methods for asynchronous request processing.
items.translation: 扩展带有异步请求处理方法NativeWebRequest。

items.source: A Servlet implementation of AsyncWebRequest.
items.translation: 一个 `AsyncWebRequest` 接口的 Servlet 实现。

items.source: Invoked before the start of concurrent handling in the original thread in which the Callable is submitted for concurrent handling.
items.translation: 在原始线程中提交 `Callable` 以进行并发处理之前，在原始线程中调用。

items.source: Iterate over registered HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers and invoke the one that supports it.
items.translation: 遍历已注册的 HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers 并调用支持它的那个。

items.source: MVC infrastructure for annotation-based handler method processing, building on the org.springframework.web.method.annotation package.
items.translation: 基于 org.springframework.web.method.annotation 包构建的用于注解式处理器方法处理的 MVC 基础设施。

items.source: Invoked from a container thread when an error occurred while processing the async request before the Callable task completes.
items.translation: 在 `Callable` 任务完成之前，如果在处理异步请求时发生错误，则会在容器线程中调用此方法。

items.source: Invoked from a container thread when an error occurred while processing an async request before the DeferredResult has been set.
items.translation: 在设置 `DeferredResult` 之前，如果在处理异步请求时发生错误，则会在容器线程中调用。

items.source: Invoked from a container thread when the async request times out before the Callable task completes.
items.translation: 在异步请求超时且 `Callable` 任务未完成时，由容器线程调用。

items.source: Invoked from a container thread when an async request times out before the DeferredResult has been set.
items.translation: 在异步请求超时且尚未设置 `DeferredResult` 时，由容器线程调用。

items.source: Invoked when a named value is present but becomes null after conversion.
items.translation: 当存在命名值但在转换后变为null时触发。

items.source: Initialize a WebDataBinder with @InitBinder methods.
items.translation: 使用带有 `@InitBinder` 方法的 `WebDataBinder` 进行初始化。

items.source: Populate the model in the following order: Retrieve "known" session attributes listed as @SessionAttributes.
items.translation: 按以下顺序填充模型： 检索列为 `@SessionAttributes` 的“已知”会话属性。

items.source: Promote model attributes listed as @SessionAttributes to the session.
items.translation: 将列为@SessionAttributes的模型属性提升到会话中。

items.source: This package contains classes used to determine the requested the media types in a request.
items.translation: 该包包含用于确定请求中请求的媒体类型的类。

items.source: Support classes for web data binding.
items.translation: 支持 Web 数据绑定的类。

items.source:
Support for generic request context holding, in particular for
scoping of application objects per HTTP request or HTTP session.
items.translation: 支持通用请求上下文持有，特别是针对每个 HTTP 请求或 HTTP 会话的应用程序对象作用域。

items.source: Support for asynchronous request processing.
items.translation: 支持异步请求处理。

items.source: Support classes for annotation-based handler method processing.
items.translation: 支持基于注解的处理方法处理的辅助类。

items.source: Generic support classes for handler method processing.
items.translation: 处理处理器方法的通用支持类。

items.source: Support classes for the multipart resolution framework.
items.translation: 支持多部分解析框架的辅助类。

items.source:
Provides standard HandlerMapping implementations,
including abstract base classes for custom implementations.
items.translation: 提供标准的 HandlerMapping 实现，包括用于自定义实现的抽象基类。

items.source: Support package for annotation-based Servlet MVC controllers.
items.translation: 支持基于注解的 Servlet MVC 控制器的支持包。

items.source: Extract a key from the request to use to look up media types.
items.translation: 从请求中提取一个键，用于查找媒体类型。

items.source: Override to provide handling when a key is not resolved via.
items.translation: 重写以提供在通过...无法解析键时的处理。

items.source: Extension point to create the WebDataBinder instance.
items.translation: 用于创建 WebDataBinder 实例的扩展点。

items.source: Resolve an argument for the given handler method parameter within the given web request.
items.translation: 在给定 Web 请求中，为给定的处理器方法参数解析一个参数。

items.source:
Invoked from a container thread when async processing completes for any
reason including timeout or network error.
items.translation: 由容器线程在异步处理因任何原因（包括超时或网络错误）完成时调用。

items.source:
Invoked from a container thread when an async request completed for any
reason including timeout and network error.
items.translation: 由容器线程调用，当异步请求因任何原因（包括超时和网络错误）完成时。

items.source:
Invoked immediately before the start of concurrent handling, in the same
thread that started it.
items.translation: 在并发处理开始之前立即被调用，且在与启动该处理的同一线程中执行。

items.source:
Invoked immediately after the start of concurrent handling, in the same
thread that started it.
items.translation: 在并发处理的开始阶段立即被调用，且在与启动该处理相同的线程中执行。

items.source: Extension point to bind the request to the target object via setters/fields.
items.translation: 通过 setter/field 将请求绑定到目标对象的扩展点。

items.source: Extension point to create the attribute, binding the request to constructor args.
items.translation: 用于创建属性并将请求绑定到构造函数参数的扩展点。

items.source:
Extension point to create the model attribute if not found in the model,
with subsequent parameter binding through bean properties (unless suppressed).
items.translation: 用于在模型中未找到时创建模型属性的扩展点，随后通过 Bean 属性进行参数绑定（除非被抑制）。

items.source: Invoked after a value is resolved.
items.translation: 在解析值后调用。

items.source:
Resolve the argument from the model or if not found instantiate it with
its default if it is available.
items.translation: 从模型中解析该参数，如果未找到且存在默认值，则使用其默认值进行实例化。

items.source: Resolve the given parameter type and value name into an argument value.
items.translation: 将给定的参数类型和值名解析为参数值。

items.source:
Get the method argument values for the current request, checking the provided
argument values and falling back to the configured argument resolvers.
items.translation: 获取当前请求的方法参数值，检查提供的参数值并回退到配置的参数解析器。

items.source: Invoke the method after resolving its argument values in the context of the given request.
items.translation: 在给定请求的上下文中解析其参数值后调用该方法。

items.source: Resolves a method parameter into an argument value from a given request.
items.translation: 将方法参数解析为给定请求中的参数值。

items.source:
Instantiate the model attribute from a URI template variable or from a
request parameter if the name matches to the model attribute name and
if there is an appropriate type conversion strategy.
items.translation: 如果名称与模型属性名称匹配且存在适当的类型转换策略，则从 URI 模板变量或请求参数实例化模型属性。

items.source:
Create a model attribute from a String request value (for example, URI template
variable, request parameter) using type conversion.
items.translation: 使用类型转换从字符串请求值（例如，URI 模板变量、请求参数）创建模型属性。

items.source:
Obtain a value from the request that may be used to instantiate the
model attribute through type conversion from String to the target type.
items.translation: 从请求中获取一个值，该值可通过从 String 到目标类型的类型转换用于实例化模型属性。

items.source:
Create the method argument value of the expected parameter type by
reading from the given request.
items.translation: 通过读取给定的请求来创建预期参数类型的该方法参数值。

items.source: Return a Map with all URI template variables or an empty map.
items.translation: 返回包含所有 URI 模板变量的 Map，或返回一个空 Map。

items.source: Throws MethodArgumentNotValidException if validation fails.
items.translation: 抛出 MethodArgumentNotValidException 异常，如果验证失败。

items.source: Writes the given return value to the given web request.
items.translation: 将给定的返回值写入给定的 Web 请求。
